selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline state before changes: /tmp not separately mounted, /dev/shm lacked noexec
selected_evidence.summary: findmnt/fstab/systemctl showed /tmp was part of the root filesystem (no separate mount) and /dev/shm was tmpfs with only nosuid,nodev (no noexec) before any changes

selected_evidence.requirement: Persist noexec,nosuid,nodev for /tmp and /dev/shm across reboots (fstab configuration)
selected_evidence.summary: Appended tmpfs fstab entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec after backing up the original fstab

selected_evidence.requirement: Apply the hardened mount options live and confirm active options
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl daemon-reload, mount /tmp, and remount /dev/shm applied the new options; findmnt confirmed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on both mounts

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof that program execution is ignored/blocked on /tmp and /dev/shm (pre-reboot)
selected_evidence.summary: Copied and chmod +x'd /bin/true into /tmp and /dev/shm; executing it returned 'Permission denied' with exit code 126 on both, proving noexec is enforced

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before restart (boot identity + mount health)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66) and confirmed /tmp and /dev/shm both showed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec via findmnt immediately before the restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returns before disconnection; node actually goes down
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot was scheduled via a backgrounded delayed command, returning 'reboot scheduled' successfully; the immediate next probe failed with connection reset, confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Poll until node1 is reachable again after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Repeated probes timed out/reset while node1 was rebooting, then succeeded once the node came back online

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof that boot identity changed (real restart, not just elapsed time)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id was 92b019c3-f0f4-4b9f-b211-4f7631680910, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, with uptime showing 'up 0 min', directly proving a fresh boot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: mount options for /tmp and /dev/shm persisted and are healthy
selected_evidence.summary: findmnt after reboot showed /tmp and /dev/shm both still mounted with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec, confirming the fstab entries survived reboot without manual intervention

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart functional proof that noexec/nosuid/nodev are still enforced
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, copying and executing a test binary from /tmp and /dev/shm again returned 'Permission denied' (exit 126) on both, confirming the hardening persisted through the restart
